access_note: Public metadata is open. Applications range from public to account, approval or project-restricted access; analysis-environment use is through joint research. Terms allow separately contracted fees and future charging.
description: JAMSTEC and DIAS partners operate a data and model integration platform for environmental research and disaster-risk management. DIAS combines satellite, ground-observation and model datasets with metadata services, analysis environments and web applications. Its documented water-sector applications include flood forecasting, reservoir operation and hydropower planning. The global platform supports formats such as NetCDF and CSV, subject to individual service interfaces. Current terms provide free service with possible separately contracted fees; datasets and applications retain their own conditions. Accounts, provider approval or project membership may be required, and unavailable datasets are a limitation for reproducibility. Execution was not tested. The catalogue’s data-cygma-gridded-crop-yields-dias is one hosted dataset, not coverage of this platform.
